Independent reproduction /tmp/opencode/crown-audit.py: Floyd–Warshall distances, union of geodesic intervals and single-deletion minimality for every subset at n=3..7. Geodetic totals 39,177,783,3389,14409; minimal totals 5,6,7,28,149. All polynomial coefficients and maximal minimal sizes agree.
correctness.rationale: A deleted-matching pair has a length-three interval containing every vertex, including at n=3. Without a selected matched pair, an omitted a_i can only be covered by two selected B vertices with indices different from i, and vice versa. Outside the two full-shore cases, both shores have omissions; if J is nonempty, an index of J is such an omitted A index and forces |J|>=3, and J empty also fails to cover an omitted A vertex. Symmetry yields the disjoint 3+3 threshold. Weighted index states give the matched-pair term; the disjoint k-index assignment excludes 2(1+k+binom(k,2)) choices. Monotonicity then leaves exactly the stated minimal types and gives g^+=n and n+2+20 binom(n,6).
residual_risks: Finite reproduction is supplementary; the interval proof supplies the general claim.
